retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical 80s-style layout featuring a central vertical metallic object flanked by dual columns of serif text on a deep black field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition centered on a vertical, polished gold screw-like trophy standing on a base, set against a solid black background. The layout is strictly symmetrical, with two columns of white and gold serif text listing names and titles, topped by a large, beveled gold title.
coreVisualRelationships: Central vertical axis defined by a metallic object
High contrast between gold/white elements and black void
Hierarchical scaling from large top title to small metadata
coreInvariants: Polished gold metallic texture on central object
Serif typeface for all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A tall, slender gold screw trophy occupies the central vertical third of the frame, reaching from the bottom base to just below the top title.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, beveled gold title at the top center and the base of the trophy at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top title, move down the central trophy, then scan left-to-right across the symmetrical text columns.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds all elements, emphasizing the 'floating' quality of the gold and white components.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for primary text names.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Polished gold with yellow and orange highlights for the central object and titles.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast; metallic elements use a full range from white highlights to dark brown shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic transitional serif with moderate contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Top title features a 3D beveled effect with an orange-to-yellow gradient and a thin gold outline.

treatment.fill: white for names, gold for titles

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single serif family used in different weights and colors to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small metadata text at the very top edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 80s editorial serif aesthetic and weight.
Classic structure that supports the 3D treatment well.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background with a central, vertically oriented polished gold screw trophy standing on a black circular base. The trophy should have high-specular highlights and deep amber shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large beveled gold serif title at the top. Arrange two columns of text on either side of the trophy using a classic serif font, alternating between white and gold for names and sub-titles.

verificationChecks: Does the central object have a metallic gold finish?

adjustableVariables: Central object type (e.g., trophy, pillar, statue)
mustRedesign: Original artist names and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the black background.
Verify the gold gradient in the title matches the trophy's lighting.
Check that the symmetry is not broken by text length.
Confirm the absence of any modern digital artifacts or UI elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical black-field layout + central metallic icon + dual-column serif typography.
